entries.name: cdrom driver request
entries.description: Sends the CD-ROM device driver request header at ES:BX to the driver of drive CX.
entries.behaviour: Writes the drive's sub-unit into byte 1 of the header and runs the emulator's driver strategy and interrupt handlers directly; CF is clear and the status word is in the header. A CX that is not a CD-ROM drive gives AX=000Fh and CF set.
